content.comment_body: A new feature in [product_name] [version_no] allows easier connection of pins that are located far apart, even across different pages. Previously, connecting distant pins required accessing the context menu and selecting from a list of blocks. Now, you can open a single diagram in two separate views, each showing a different diagram section, and drag-and-drop between pins to make connections. To do this: activate split mode via the toolbar, then use CTRL+Drag to move the diagram tab to the split view. This streamlines workflow for connecting distant elements.
This is a great improvement, thank you.

analysis.insight_summary: The recent update in [product_name] [version_no] introduces a split view feature, making it much easier to link pins on different parts or pages of a schematic diagram by drag-and-drop, rather than relying on the traditional menu. This results in a smoother and faster workflow.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate a more efficient process for connecting remote pins and better navigation within complex schematics.
